name: ai-resume-matcher
description: AI-powered resume matcher and skill gap analyzer using local embeddings and a local LLM.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names shared,api --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev -w @resume-matcher/shared" "npm run start:dev -w @resume-matcher/backend"
scripts.seed:admin: npm run build -w @resume-matcher/shared && npm run seed:admin -w @resume-matcher/backend
